package cursor_flow
namespace cursor_flow
entity Integer id "urn:gooo:type:integer"
activity 요금(Integer) -> Integer id "urn:cursor:charge" computes "return input + 7"
activity Runner(Integer) -> Integer computes "let label = \"Charge(input) stays text\"; if len(label) > 0 { return 요금(input) }; return input"
activity Notes(Integer) -> Integer computes `// Charge in this note is prose.
return 요금(input)
`
